The right half of the section, where the H2, lede, limit and note sit, is flat #03040B black with no environment. With the push zoom it reads as an image box on the left plus a text column on black, which is the 'two boxes / visible image edge' the client rejected. On mobile, the vertical plate also keeps the scene inside a vignetted rectangle with dark bands left and right, and the chat card sits directly below it.
evidence: Real-scroll CDP captures of the pinned state: /private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-riklanderos-Web-Ingeniak-Versel/e64796e3-3852-42c2-8549-9c83b0f55e3b/scratchpad/advsal2/w1440/05.png, w1280/06.png, w1920/05.png, w2560/05.png. Mobile: w390/07.png, w360/07.png. Pixel row through the counter strip (mean RGB): 1440 → 138@x630, 59@x690, 9@x750, then flat 6–9 to x1440. 1920 → 188@x800, 12@x960, flat 6–8 after. 2560 → 161@x848, 7@x1060, flat after. The plate source public/img/cine/ind-salud-kain-sector-1280.webp (converted at advsal2/ks-plate.png) is already black from x≈0.52. The mobile master (advsal2/ks-plate-m.png) has the scene boxed between x≈0.18 and 0.95. The hero (smooth fade over ~500 px at 2560) and the Dawn close do not have this problem.
fix: Regenerate or outpaint ind-salud-kain-sector (desktop and -m) so the clinic reception keeps going across the whole frame behind the text side. It should be darker and low-detail, with the waiting area or chairs softly out of focus, the counter glow fading out gradually instead of being cut, and a navy haze rather than pure #03040B. Then re-run plates.mjs and check-escenas. Until the new plate exists, cine can soften the plate's right edge (a wider mask ramp of ≥25% of the width, plus a blurred mirrored extension of the plate under .is__copy) so no vertical seam shows at the counter line.

problem: Behind each Montage row, the backdrop is the portrait of the Monterrey dental-case dentist, including row 3. Row 3 is salud-citas-mes, an aggregate of 'Clientes del sector salud' with no case link. That pairs an aggregate figure with one specific clinic's person (and the inline label only says 'Imagen ilustrativa'). The same face also repeats three rows in a row, which reads as a ghostly stock photo rather than art direction.
evidence: src/styles/pages.css:124 `.mt__row:has([data-metric="dental-citas"],[data-metric="dental-respuesta"],[data-metric="salud-citas-mes"]){--case-img:url(/img/cine/caso-dental-hero-still-640.webp)}`. elementsFromPoint at the '47' of row 3: `LI.mt__row.mt__row--l ::after=url(.../caso-dental-hero-still-640.webp)`. Captures: advsal2/mt1440.png, w1440/07.png, w390/09.png.
fix: Remove salud-citas-mes, and any other aggregate metric with no case href, from the case-portrait :has() rule. Let it use the sector still (ind-salud-hero-still) or an aura, and use a different crop for rows 1–2 so the same face never appears twice in a row.

problem: The H2 'Lo que ya pasó en clínicas reales.' states as fact that the results come from several real clinics. Only one clinic is confirmed (the dental clinic in Monterrey). The third figure's source is 'Clientes del sector salud', and the copy file itself lists as an open client question what type those health clients are. fix: Reword to something already supported by the sources, for example 'Lo que ya pasó con clientes del sector salud.' or 'Resultados reales del sector salud.', until the client confirms the types of health clients.

problem: At 320 px the cyan/white node circle of the primary 'Agenda tu Discovery Session' button spills out of the pill's right edge. The button spans x 20–300 and the .btn__node spans 274–310, so 10 px stick out. The main CTA looks broken on small Android and SE-size phones.

problem: The context line of the anchored chip ('Clínica dental · Monterrey') fails WCAG AA. It measures 4.37:1 against its glass background, and 4.5:1 is needed for that small mono size.
evidence: node scripts/check-contraste.mjs --only /industrias/salud/ → '✗ /industrias/salud/#hero @1920x1080 · 1 línea(s) bajo AA; peor 4.37:1 (necesita 4.5:1, fondo L 0.058): "Clínica dental · Monterrey"' (advsal2/contraste.log). It was the only contrast failure across 360, 390, 1280, 1440, 1920 and 2560.
fix: Raise the chip ctx color (for example var(--muted) to a lighter token) or the chip glass opacity in the Metric chip variant so the line reaches ≥ 4.5:1.

problem: There is a hard, full-height vertical edge on the subject side of the SystemRuntime plates. This breaks the must-have (no visible image edges or hard seams). The media layer `.seq__layer` is boxed to x=360..2200 at 2560 and x=40..1880 at 1920. It has only the vertical mask on the subject side, because the subject-right recipe sets --mR:0. But the stagebox is centered, so it does not sit flush with the window edge. The plate ends in a straight cut 360 px before the window edge.
evidence: Measured with CDP while pinned at 2560x1080: `DIV.is__layer--media.seq__layer x=360..2200`, `IMG home-sistema-1-atraer-1920.avif x=288..2223`. Pixel row y=500 in adv2h/2560x1080/05-sistema.jpg: (11,16,36) at x=2198 → (3,3,13) at x=2204. In 08-sistema.jpg the automation node graph is cut mid-node at x≈2200 (crop z-sis2560b.png). At 1920 the same jump happens at x=1880: (11,19,40) → (0,3,20). The rule is src/styles/cine.css:86-103. `.is[data-layout="subject-right"] > .is__stagebox{right:0}` never reaches `.seq__stagebox`, but `--mR:0px` still applies. Screens: adv2h/2560x1080/05–09-sistema.jpg.
fix: For PlateSequence on screens ≥1800 px, anchor `.seq__stagebox` flush to the window edge on the subject's side, the way ImageSection does (right:0; width:min(100%,var(--cap))). Otherwise, compute --mR/--mL from the real inset so that any edge that does not touch the window gets the 10–28 % feathered mask. Re-check all 5 stations at 1920x1080 and 2560x1080, pinned and unpinned.

problem: Kain is never visible full body on desktop. The section is 1.2–1.8 viewports tall, because the H2, the lede, the 8-row list, the chat sim and the footer all stack in it. The sector plate is cover-scaled to the whole section height, so Kain renders about 1,000–1,200 px tall. At any scroll position you see either his head over the list or his legs a screen later. This repeats right after the VKTOR Kain, so two half-Kains read as cropped.
evidence: CDP: indH/imgH 1281/1281 px at 720 vh, 1270/1270 at 900 vh, 1420/1420 at 1080 vh, 1244/1244 at 2560x1080 (img 2295x1281, 2275x1270, 2544x1420, 2228x1244). Screens: adv2h/1280x720/21–23-industrias.jpg (head, then torso, then feet on separate screens), 1920x1080/16–17-industrias.jpg, 1440x900/19-industrias.jpg (antennas cut at the top edge).
fix: Pin the plate layer as a sticky 100svh stage, with the subject anchored bottom and fully in frame, and let the list column scroll over it. Alternatively, cap the plate height at 100svh, anchored to the section bottom, and fade it to ink above. Or compress the rows and chat so the section is ≤ 100svh on desktop. Kain must fit head to feet in one screen at 1280x720 and 1440x900.

problem: A claim that is still waiting on the client is stated as fact. 'Diseñamos e implementamos … un solo sistema que atiende, califica y cierra por ti, 24/7.' Copy's own review package flags 'cierra por ti' as promising more than the product does, because the agent hands off to a person to close. The page contradicts it twice: #sistema says 'si hace falta una persona, le pasa la conversación' and the Kain limit says 'se la paso a tu equipo'. Decision 2 requires rewording or hiding unconfirmed claims. Two smaller pending questions are also printed as fact: 'lo operamos automáticamente' (#sistema H2) and 'Seis personas que diseñan, construyen y operan tu sistema' (#equipo).
evidence: src/content/paginas/home.json pendientes: 'PREGUNTA AL CLIENTE · lede del manifiesto … "cierra por ti" promete más. Propuesta: "…que atiende, califica y agenda por ti, 24/7." No se cambió sin tu visto bueno.', plus the questions on 'automáticamente' and 'Seis personas'. The text is live: adv2h/1440x900/04-que-es.jpg, 1920x1080/04-que-es.jpg.
fix: Use the proposed safe wording now: '…que atiende, califica y agenda por ti, 24/7.' Keep the original in pendientes so it can return once confirmed in writing. Soften the #sistema H2, e.g. 'y lo operamos contigo', and drop 'Seis' or keep it neutral until the client confirms.

viewport: 1280x720, 1440x900 (real wheel scroll through Dawn into footer)
problem: In 'labels' mode, the case page's scene rail (01 — Contexto / 02 — La cifra / 03 — Replicar, with its dark halo box) stays on top of the footer. It covers the Recursos column links for about 300 px of scroll, and those links can't be read. Two causes. First, rail.ts guardLabels only tests elements inside <main> (`!main.contains(el)` → continue), so footer links never count as 'covered'. Second, the rail only hides on html[data-end-visible], which turns on about 300 px after the footer arrives. Before that, the same dark box sits on the Dawn plate beside Kain (closing shot at 1440 and 1920).
evidence: CDP probe (wheel scroll, read 2.6 s after stopping). At 1280x720, scrollY 4920, rail labels overlap 'Cuánto cuesta un agente de IA' and 'Kommo vs GoHighLevel'. At 1440x900, scrollY 5348–5538, they overlap 'Blog', 'Cuánto cuesta…', 'Cómo verificar un partner de Kommo', 'GoHighLevel en español' and 'n8n vs Zapier vs Make' (railOp=1, no data-end-visible). Screenshots in /private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-riklanderos-Web-Ingeniak-Versel/e64796e3-3852-42c2-8549-9c83b0f55e3b/scratchpad/rv2caso/: z-rail1280-0-4700.png, z-foot-rail.png (zoom of s/1440x900/07-y5600.png); rail box over the Dawn plate: s/1440x900/06-y4800.png, s/1920x1080/06-y5400.png.
fix: Hide the rail once the last rail scene ends. Its list stops at Replicar, so the simplest fix is to add `html[data-dawn-visible] .rail` to the hide rule next to data-end-visible, the same as KainPill (§4.6). Alternatively, add a footer IntersectionObserver that sets data-footer-visible. Also, in guardLabels, treat elements in <footer> like <main> content, so a covered label is withdrawn there too.

problem: Client gates, for information only, not defects: (1) caso-dental.json is still estado 'borrador' with aprobadoPor null. (2) The R2 publishGate is not confirmed, so the page ships as a short case ('caso breve'): noindex,follow, and Punto de partida, Implementación, Resultado (the Kain mid-page scene) and VKTOR are left out of the HTML. problem: The hero's Fig. 01 glass caption ('La silla vacía · La pregunta de esta llamada…') gets cut by the hero's overflow:clip while the page scrolls out. The exit drift moves the caption down more slowly than the section, so its bottom passes the section edge. The box loses its bottom border and a line of text is cut in half. At 1280x800 'estás.' disappears; at 2560x1080 the second line is cut through the glyphs. The caption also sits on top of the chair base (the subject itself). §3.8 asks for the caption to sit on the floor between the text column and the subject's feet.
evidence: CDP real scroll, wait ≥3 s. At 1280x800, y=690: caption 48–123 px, hero bottom 110. At 2560x1080, y=918: caption 113–168, hero bottom 162; y=1000: caption 35–90, hero bottom 80. A 40 px sweep shows the clipping lasts for every y ≥ 520 at 1280x800 (up to 15 px of the 75 px box) and every y ≥ 840 at 2560x1080 (10 px). The hero section computes overflow:clip. Captures: scratchpad/adv2disc/z-f1280.png, z-fig918.png, z-fig1000.png. At y=0 the caption starts only 47 px above the hero bottom at 2560x1080 (953–1033 vs 1080). The plate anchor fig.d is [0.72, 0.85].
fix: Make sure the caption never crosses the section edge. Either clamp its top to (section height − caption height − 24 px), or take .cv-fig out of the downward exit drift (keep it static or let it move up). Also move the fig anchor up and to the left (≈0.62, 0.78) so it sits on the floor between the text and the chair, not over the chair base. Check at 1280x800, 1440x900, 2560x1080 and 3440x1440.

problem: At 320–340 px the blue primary CTA overflows. The label 'Agendar mi Discovery Session' is nowrap and needs 222 px, plus padding and the node, so the button wants 310 px in a 280 px column. In the hero the node circle sticks 20 px out of the right end of the button. In #despues and #cta-final the button is 310 px wide and runs 10 px past the viewport. overflow-x hides it, so the button's right cap and node are cut off at the screen edge. The microcopy 'sin costo' touches the edge, and the Dawn text column widens to 310 px. The hero chip 'LLAMADA 1:1 · 30 MINUTOS · SIN COSTO' also wraps and leaves 'COSTO' alone on its own line.
evidence: CDP at 320x640 (mobile emulation). Hero btn 20–300, node 284–320. #despues btn 20–330, node 284–320. #cta-final btn 20–330. At 340: hero node 285–321 vs btn right 319; #despues/#cta-final right gutter is 9 px vs 21 px on the left. Fine at 360. Captures: scratchpad/adv2disc/m320/m320-top.png, m320-after.png, m320-dawn.png.
fix: Below about 360 px, let .btn shrink. Set .btn{max-width:100%} with min-width:0 on .ctas/.cta-p, and let .btn__t wrap (white-space:normal, text-align:left) or reduce the horizontal padding and node size. The node must stay inside the pill. Add letter-spacing or allow a cleaner break in .cv-hero__chip so 'SIN COSTO' stays together. Check at 320, 340 and 360.

problem: The VSL opens inside a black box. The rule `.vdialog__stage video{width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:contain}` stretches the <video> element to the full stage. The browser's default black video background then shows as a hard-edged black rectangle. On a phone the box is 363x744 with the 16:9 picture (~205 px tall) floating in the middle: about 70% of the screen is flat black against the navy dialog. On desktop the box adds 23 px black bars above and below the picture. This is the main conversion asset of the page, and R7 bans a boxed player.
evidence: CDP 390x844 after tapping play: dialog 390x844, video element [14, 72, 363, 744], close button 44x44 (OK). Capture scratchpad/adv2disc/vslm/vslm-open.png. At 1440x900 the video element is 1339x800 for a 16:9 source (picture ≈753 px tall). Capture vsl/vsl-open.png. Focus trap, Esc, pausing and returning focus to the trigger all work.
fix: Size the element to the video's aspect ratio instead of the stage: `.vdialog__stage video{width:100%;height:auto;max-height:100%;aspect-ratio:16/9;background:transparent}` (or background:var(--ink-2)). Keep it centered with the grid. In portrait, optionally place the title and close button above a centered 16:9 frame.

problem: In #despues, the mobile-only sticky isotipo aura (<Aura kind='isotipo' x='65%' o={0.9} only='m' sticky/>) slides behind the blue CTA and its microcopy. On tablet portrait the 12 px microcopy '30 min · 1:1 · Google Meet · sin costo' (#9EB0C7) falls to about 1.5:1 contrast. The blue button also blends into the cyan blob, so the one primary CTA on the screen loses its edge.
evidence: 8-step real-scroll sweep (2 s wait, DPR 2), median background under the micro. At 768x1024 with the micro at viewport y=964/835/706: contrast 1.53/1.55/1.67. At y=577–61: 3.9–4.6, still under 4.5 at most positions. At 390x844, y=475: 3.19. Capture scratchpad/adv2disc/z-msw768.png and t768/05-s4-y5120.png.
fix: In ConversionTemplate, move the mobile aura of the 'intertitle' scene away from .cv-after__ctas: anchor it near the H2 or at x≈20%, or lower it to o≤0.35. Another option is a local scrim (radial ink) under .cv-after__ctas. Re-measure the micro at ≥4.5:1 at every scroll position on 768x1024, 390x844 and 360x740.

problem: In the VideoScene the text columns press into the subject (the chair). At 1024x768 the 'es' of 'antes' in the H2 sits over the left edge of the seat, and 'Reproducir el video' butts against the right armrest. At 2560x1080 the H2 ends about 12 px from the seat. evidence: Subject box (plate subject.d 0.375–0.66) overlap from the real-scroll scan. 1024x768: H2 24%, lede 16%, 'Si reconociste…' 20%. 1440x900: H2 17%. 1920x1080: 19%. 2560x1080: 22%. Captures: scratchpad/adv2disc/z-v1024.png, z-v2560.png.

problem: The play button's micro label reads 'VSL · 3:00'. VSL is internal marketing jargon ('video sales letter'). A business owner who knows the term reads it as 'sales video', on a page whose promise is 'No es una venta' and 'Sin discurso de venta'.

problem: The vertical Dawn plate tells a different story from the desktop plate. Desktop discovery-cta-final shows Kain seated in the owner's chair: the payoff of the 'silla vacía' metaphor (§5.11; the IMAGENES plan says the mobile plate is the 'same instruction'). discovery-cta-final-m shows Kain standing next to the empty chair. On phones the page ends without 'the chair is no longer empty'. Kain is full body, so the brand rule is met.

fix: Regenerate the 4:5 master with Kain seated in the chair, full body, feet on the base or floor, waving toward the text side. Keep the top 37% as clean shadow, then run scripts/plates.mjs. The anchors m (pecho, mano, silla) need updating.

problem: On small phones the first screen of the hero is text only. The subject's head lands at 650 px, just below the fold, so the hero does not read as an image section above the fold. cine's own guard flags it.
evidence: Dev console at 320x640: "[cine] #hero: la cabeza del sujeto cae a 650 px (1.02 de la pantalla; tope 0.8). Usa mobile=\"split\" o acorta el intro." Capture scratchpad/adv2disc/m320/m320-top.png. 360x740 and 390x844 are fine.
fix: At ≤340 px, tighten the intro: reduce the H1 and deck one step, use one short lede sentence, and keep the chip on one line. The plate should start at ≤0.8 of the screen. Re-check the guard at 320x640.

problem: Without JS the FAQ answers render expanded. Each toggle still says aria-expanded="false", shows a '+' icon and does nothing. Screen readers announce collapsed while the answer is visible.
evidence: Server HTML: <button class="faq__q" aria-expanded="false" aria-controls="faq-list-a0" data-faq-toggle> with the answer visible. No-JS capture (Emulation.setScriptExecutionDisabled): scratchpad/adv2disc/nojs/nojs-faq.png. Everything else is visible without JS and under reduced motion.
fix: Render a no-JS-safe state: aria-expanded="true" plus a '−' icon under html.no-js. Or hide the toggle semantics (question as a plain heading) until ui.ts upgrades it. Or use <details>/<summary> as the base.

problem: `astro build` prints 2 warnings, and neither is tracked in lanzamiento.md or peticiones.md. First: there is no content config, so Astro auto-generates the deprecated collections 'blog' and 'paginas'. Second: glob-loader matches no .md/.mdx in src/content/blog (empty) or src/content/paginas (JSON, read through src/lib/site).
evidence: The build report of round 2 lists both warnings. `ls src/content.config.ts src/content/config.ts` → both missing. src/content/blog is empty. grep of lanzamiento.md/peticiones.md for content.config/glob-loader finds nothing.
fix: Add src/content.config.ts. Define paginas with a file/glob loader for *.json, or declare no collections and move the JSON out of src/content. Define blog once the articles exist. Or at least log both warnings in materiales/v2/build/lanzamiento.md (orquestador).

problem: Client gate (informational): the /discovery/ copy is still 'borrador' with aprobadoPor null. The review package has open items: the D01–D04 and D06 FAQ answers are edited versus D, and the closing line 'Construimos empresarios libres, no héroes cansados.' (ESPEC §11-4) is a question to the client. The page is served index,follow today, and --release makes the gate fatal.
evidence: src/content/paginas/discovery.json: "estado": "borrador", "aprobadoPor": null, plus pendientes. <meta name="robots" content="index,follow,max-image-preview:large">. Every factual claim on the page traces to materiales/discovery/contenido.md (7 preguntas, 2 min, CDMX L–V, 24 h para reagendar, 3–40 empleados, sin tarjeta). No unconfirmed fact is stated.
fix: The client approves and names a person in aprobadoPor (the team does not change estado/aprobadoPor). Until then, the orquestador decides on noindex for draft pages as recorded in lanzamiento.md.

problem: The page states two service details as fact that the copy file itself marks as unconfirmed. Under 'Lo que sí hace' it says the handoff to a person happens 'con todo el historial' and that the agent 'Se ajusta cada mes con tus conversaciones reales'. VKTOR's Rise phase repeats the monthly claim: 'optimizamos cada mes'. Decision 2 forbids stating unconfirmed facts.
evidence: src/content/paginas/agentes-whatsapp.json pendientes: 'Confirmar que el servicio incluye: el paso a una persona "con todo el historial" y el ajuste mensual "con tus conversaciones reales" (fases Operate y Rise)'. Both lines render at 1440x900 (scratchpad svc2/d1440/s08.jpg, s13.jpg) and on mobile (svc2/m390/s13.jpg).
fix: Until the client confirms, reword without the unconfirmed specifics. For example: 'Le pasa la conversación a una persona cuando el cliente lo pide o el caso lo necesita.' Drop 'Se ajusta cada mes…' or hedge it ('Lo ajustamos con tus conversaciones reales; la frecuencia la definimos contigo'). Apply the same change to vktor.phases[R].line.

problem: The floating 'Escríbele a Kain' pill shows Kain cropped to head and shoulders (kain-avatar-96.webp). This breaks the non-negotiable brand rule that Kain always appears full body, and it stays on screen for most of the scroll.
evidence: Zoom of the pill at 1440 shows a bust crop (svc2/d1440/z-pill.png). It also appears at 1920 and 2560 next to the 'Escríbele a Kain · responde 24/7' label (svc2/d1920/s02.jpg, svc2/d2560/s02.jpg). KainPill.astro loads /img/kain/kain-avatar-96.webp; peticiones.md records it as 'cabeza y hombros'.
fix: Replace the bust with a full-body mini Kain (a tall cutout so feet and antennae show, e.g. a 28×48 crop of kain-presenta.webp), or remove the avatar and use the WhatsApp glyph plus the 'Escríbele a Kain' text. Never crop Kain.

problem: The phase columns are out of step with the V·K·T·O·R slabs on the plate. At 2560 every column sits one slab to the left: the 'V' slab is above 'K · Koncept', 'O' is above 'R · Rise', and the 'R' slab has no column under it. The text and image stop reading as one geometry.
evidence: Measured at 2560x1080: column centres are about 706/999/1292/1584/1877 px; slab centres are 998/1296/1594/1883/2350 px. At 1440 they line up within ±30 px (columns 218/475/732/988/1245, slabs 209/444/680/908/1277). At 1920 the R slab sits 150 px right of its column. Captures: svc2/vk-2560.png, svc2/d2560/s11.jpg.
fix: Place the .svc-vk__rail columns from the slab anchor x positions (left/width from --ax of each svc-slab), or limit the plate width on ≥1800 px so the slabs fall inside .frame. Re-check at 1920 and 2560.

problem: On mobile, only the Salud row has the 'VER INDUSTRIA →' link, and it takes its own column. That squeezes the row's title and description into a narrow strip: 75 px at 320, 118 px at 360 and 144 px at 390, against about 260 px in the sibling rows. The description breaks into 4 to 6 lines of one or two words each.
evidence: Measured: 'Agenda, confirma y recuerda…' is w=118 px, h=113 px at 360 and w=144 px at 390. Captures: svc2/m390-indrow-c.png, svc2/m320-ind.png (320 shows 'Agenda, / confirma y / recuerda / citas, sin / dar').
fix: Under 768 px, put the link on its own line below the description (or make the whole row the link and drop the text label), so all four rows keep the same text width.

problem: At 320 px the hero's primary button 'Agenda tu Discovery Session' doesn't fit. Its round node icon sticks out about 10 px past the right edge of the blue pill.
evidence: In the DOM the .btn has scrollWidth 290 and clientWidth 280. The 2x capture shows the circle outside the pill: svc2/m320-top.png.
fix: In Btn/.btn under about 340 px, let the label wrap or shrink: allow letter-spacing/padding to compress, or hide .btn__node (the MobileCTABar already drops it). The pill must contain the icon.

problem: The Fig. 02 caption reads 'LO QUE PASA A LAS 11:48 P. M.' with no 'Ejemplo ilustrativo' label, so the narrative hour reads as a fact. F16 requires that label on the 11:48 p. m. hour. The text is also hardcoded in the template as a fallback instead of coming from the copy JSON.
evidence: ServiceTemplate.astro line 196: C[painS.id]?.fig?.label ?? 'Lo que pasa a las 11:48 p. m.' (agentes-whatsapp.json has no senales.fig). Rendered in svc2/d1440b/s05.jpg and svc2/d1920/s02.jpg.
fix: Move the label into copy (senales.fig.label) and render it as 'Fig. 02 · Ejemplo ilustrativo: lo que pasa a las 11:48 p. m.'. Alternatively, drop the hour and keep a non-numeric caption. No page text in the template.

problem: The related still 'Caso de estudio · Clínica dental en Monterrey' shows a generated dentist's face with no 'Imagen ilustrativa' label. That suggests the person is the real (anonymized) client. The Montage on the same page labels the same kind of image 'IMAGEN ILUSTRATIVA', so the page is inconsistent.
evidence: svc2/rel-2x.png (1440 @2x) and svc2/m-rel-2x.png (390 @2x): no illustrative chip on the dentist still. The Montage rows in svc2/d1440/s09.jpg do have it.
fix: Apply the Montage rule to Still: when the plate shows people (not Kain), render chip-illus 'Imagen ilustrativa' inside the still's penumbra.

problem: The hero lede gives a real result ('…el tiempo de respuesta bajó de 8 minutos a 12 segundos') with no source note. §0.1-2 requires the note 'Datos internos de Ingeniak, octubre de 2026' on every figure, and the hero section contains no 'Datos internos' text. The note first appears in #definicion, a screen later.
evidence: In the page HTML, the #hero slice has 0 occurrences of 'Datos internos'. The metric span data-metric="dental-respuesta" has no superscript (svc2/d1440/s00.jpg, svc2/m390/s01.jpg).
fix: Add the footnote mark ¹ to the hero metric and the source note in the hero microcopy area, as the definicion MetricRow does. Keep it inside the text column, not over Kain.

problem: The meta description shows a bare figure ('Caso real: tiempo de respuesta de 8 minutos a 12 segundos.') with no sector, city or source. This is the most-copied snippet of the page, and §0.1-2 requires context on every figure.
